items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: I was here in Aix en Provence with Jean Paul where we’re at

ctx.x: So actually what happened is that I remember I played a concert at a jazz festival in the middle of France in a city called Clermont-Ferrand, and the jazz director, the director of the festival that night we were hanging out after the concert, and he said, “Wow why don’t you propose Ray Brown to play some duets with you?” Okay? And the next day I was here in Aix en Provence with Jean Paul where we’re at — and at the end of the night he told me the same thing. And then the next day I went back to Paris and another…
